# Watchlist brief: 2026-10-21

*Sample data for the test environment: prices and news are simulated.*

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 1.25% (z-score 1.4). Strongest sector: Technology (XLK) +2.11%; weakest: Industrials (XLI) +0.76%. Unusual sector moves: Consumer Discretionary +2.08% (z-score 2.0).

## Notable moves

### MSFT: +4.82% (z-score 2.24, volume 0.8x normal)
- **What happened:** MSFT moved +4.82% on volume 0.8x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** MSFT rose 4.82%; its sector (Technology, XLK) rose 2.11% and the S&P 500 rose 1.25%. Part of the move matches its sector, but MSFT did 2.71 points better: a wider gap than usual, though not an unusual one (z-score 1.6). Company news may explain the rest.
- **Likely why:** No clear catalyst found.
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

### AMZN: -5.58% (z-score -2.63, volume 2.11x normal)
- **What happened:** AMZN moved -5.58% on volume 2.11x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** AMZN fell 5.58%; its sector (Consumer Discretionary, XLY) rose 2.08% and the S&P 500 rose 1.25%. That is 7.67 points worse than its sector, an unusual gap for AMZN (z-score -3.9), so the move looks specific to AMZN.
- **Likely why:** An analyst downgrade weighed on the shares. [Sample Wire](https://news.example.com/2026-10-21/amzn-news)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

AAPL (+1.94%), NVDA (+2.79%), JPM (+0.53%)

## Coming up

- Wed Oct 21: NVIDIA (NVDA): Product launch event
- Tue Oct 27: Microsoft (MSFT): Court hearing in patent case
- Wed Oct 28: Apple (AAPL): Earnings report
